label: site test
goal: This is a real online shop. Add any one in-stock product to the cart and go through checkout as far as the payment step, then stop. Never pay, never place or submit an order, never create an account or sign in, never type card details. If the shop asks for contact or shipping details before payment, use: full name Alex Morgan, email alex.morgan@example.com, street address 100 Example Avenue, city New York, state New York, ZIP 10001, country United States (or the closest option the shop offers), phone (212) 555-0142. Decline cookie banners, newsletters and promotions. If a cookie banner offers no way to decline that works, accept it, report that as a problem, and carry on. When you see the payment form or a button that would pay or place the order, finish with done and your findings. If you cannot get that far, give up with honest findings.

outcome.reason: Reached the payment step. Stopped there: nothing was paid.

reclassified.why: Checked by hand: the last page record shows the checkout with a Payment heading and the payment method buttons Card, PayPal and others (or the embedded payment form); the oracle counted only radio buttons as method choices.

findings.problem: The cookie dialog stayed in the page tree after I pressed Deny Cookies, so I could not tell whether the choice worked.
The first click on a product link failed because its accessible name changed after the page loaded more detail, so the name I targeted no longer existed.

Clicking a best-seller product link opened a Create an account popup instead of the product page. The wishlist button sits inside the product link and each link name starts with the word Wishlist, so I could not reach the product. I had to close the popup and try the Shoes category instead.

element.name: Wishlist The Ballet Crew Sock The Ballet Crew Sock €16

findings.problem: The Create an account dialog popped up by itself on arrival and covered the page until I closed it.

Every Add to Bag button in the product list is named quick-shop, so they cannot be told apart. Pressing it gives no clear sign: the button turns disabled and the size picker opens inside the list item, after a delay. The size buttons do not show which one is selected.

The Add to Bag result appeared in a dialog that I could not see on the step itself, and the shop gave no confirmation until I read the page again. The checkout buttons also turn into disabled or unnamed buttons while loading, with no loading message.
The Checkout as guest button is named Move to wishlist, which is misleading and sounds like a different action. It is a sign of a mislabeled button.

The country is locked to [name] and cannot be changed, so I could not choose United States. The address line is an unlabelled combobox, and the phone field is only named with an asterisk. An error that the phone number was not valid appeared only as loose text and not tied to the field, and it was caused by the default [name] phone code.
The card fields are inside an iframe with no name, and the Pay Now button is disabled with no explanation. The page also loads slowly, so I had to re-read it several times to see the payment section.
